recognize_zh: 數位影像分類系統（CellaVision）的細胞圖庫中，大量細胞核呈雙葉、摺疊或腎形（butterfly nucleus），細胞質淡藍、顆粒少，另有少數細胞帶粗顆粒與 Auer rod，這個一致性的異常族群指向 APL。
features: Monotonous population of medium-large cells with bilobed, folded, reniform or 'butterfly' nuclei
Fine chromatin with nuclear folds and grooves visible through the cytoplasm
Many cells with sparse, fine granules and pale blue cytoplasm (hypogranular appearance)
A minority of cells with coarse granules and rod-like inclusions (e.g., cells 2 and 7)
Irregular cell outlines with occasional cytoplasmic blebs
describe_en: Digital morphology gallery (CellaVision-type) displays numerous pre-classified cells from the same sample. The predominant population consists of medium to large cells with bilobed, folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin, and pale to lightly granular cytoplasm; several cells show coarse azurophilic granules with rod-like inclusions suggestive of Auer rods. Normal maturing neutrophils and lymphocytes are not represented among these cells. Findings are consistent with abnormal promyelocytes of acute promyelocytic leukemia, including hypogranular forms; automated analyzers may misclassify such cells as monocytes or blasts, so manual review is essential.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and lack Auer rod bundles, and are strongly NSE-positive with HLA-DR and CD14/CD64 expression.
Cup-like nuclear invaginations can mimic folded APL nuclei and share CD34/HLA-DR negativity, but PML::RARA is absent and faggot cells are not seen.
Mature monocytes have lacy chromatin, vacuolated gray cytoplasm and no Auer rods, with a mixed polyclonal background.
